name: touchstone
description: A verification gate for Claude Code, in C++. On every attempt to end a turn it reads the transcript and refuses "done" when the evidence contradicts it: a check that failed, a stub that was introduced (TODO/FIXME/.skip/.only/NotImplementedError), or a substantial code change with no verification behind it at all. Blocks are budgeted so it can never loop, and every failure path is fail-open. Proven by a replay benchmark in CI (11 planted fake-dones caught, 0 false positives on 10 legitimate turns) and ported from the original Python at 1146/1146 identical decisions on real transcripts. No dependencies, no skills, no MCP server, no telemetry.
